title: Seasonal allergic rhinitis
description: General educational information about seasonal nasal allergies.
content: Seasonal allergic rhinitis is an allergic response to airborne substances such as pollen. Common symptoms can include sneezing, a runny or blocked nose, and itchy or watery eyes. Symptoms and triggers vary between people. A healthcare professional can help assess persistent or disruptive symptoms and discuss appropriate options.

title: Asthma overview
description: A brief overview of asthma and common symptoms.
content: Asthma is a long-term condition affecting the airways. Symptoms can include wheezing, coughing, chest tightness, and shortness of breath, and may vary over time. Triggers differ among individuals. A clinician can assess symptoms and help create an individualized management plan. Severe breathing difficulty needs urgent medical attention.

title: Headache overview
description: General information about headaches and when to seek care.
content: Headaches have many possible causes and patterns. A headache that is sudden and severe, follows a head injury, or occurs with new weakness, confusion, vision changes, or difficulty speaking needs urgent assessment. Recurrent, worsening, or concerning headaches should be discussed with a healthcare professional. This information cannot identify the cause of an individual headache.
